thread:
Jonah: Heads-up: found a gnarly parity/dx bug in kotlin-sdk sampleapp around auth refresh + Retrofit/OkHttp interplay on Android 14 emulator. UI stutters and requests sometimes hang after a 401.
Priya: Can you share a short repro and whether it's interceptor vs Authenticator?
Jonah: Minimal repro: Kotlin sample was using a suspend-based TokenProvider but the TokenInterceptor did runBlocking to bridge it in intercept(). On 401 we rely on an OkHttp Authenticator which ends up re-entering interceptor and causing nested blocking. On some emulator images this blocks the main looper briefly.
Evelyn: That's classic. runBlocking inside interceptors is a footgun. Also note Retrofit's suspend adapters execute on the callback executor you pass; mismatch there can push work to the main thread if sample app accidentally configures it.
Jonah: Example snippet I used:
```
class SampleTokenInterceptor : Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = runBlocking { tokenProvider.getValidToken() } // <- blocking suspend bridge
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```
Priya: Under load this also causes thundering refreshes because CallTimeout cancels some calls while refresh continues, and we end up with many concurrent runBlocking calls trying to refresh.
Evelyn: Two recommended fixes for sampleapp: (1) implement a single-flight refresh helper (coalesce concurrent refreshes) and a fast-sync token cache for the happy path; (2) ensure token refresh uses IO dispatcher and never schedules to Main.
Jonah: I sketched a tiny single-flight helper in the branch using Mutex + CompletableDeferred to let concurrent callers await the same refresh. Also added a Retrofit example showing how to set the callback executor to Dispatchers.IO via Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor when mixing with callback-based adapters.
QA-Bot: Observed flaky test https://ci/internal/issue/9991 on emulator api-34 reproducer attached to PR.
Priya: Can you add a short comment in the kotlin sdk docs under "Android integration" explaining: "Do not call suspend refresh via runBlocking from interceptors/authenticators. Use sync cache + single-flight refresh or run on IO dispatcher." Also add a tiny sample for Java parity showing blocking refresh with explicit Executor to match behavior.
Jonah: Yep opened PR #1207 with sampleapp changes, docs note, and a small unit that simulates Authenticator re-entry. I attached the repro script and a grep-able log snippet.
Evelyn: Nice. Also add a note about OkHttp Dispatcher starvation and CallTimeout interactions so teams know why blocking is harmful.
Jonah: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
